## Overview

-  Goal: Recreate a dark, high-contrast marketing site section with layered isometric illustration, glassy cards, micro-glow accents, and testimonial carousel.
-  Screenshots summarized:
    - Hero: “Interact Naturally” with a glass panel modal preview, soft vignette, radial pink AI glow, ultra-dark background, thin grid lines.
    - Exploded UI diagram: isometric layers (action bar, search bar, list, selected item) in navy/blue hues with labels and dotted grid.
    - Section: “Build the perfect tools.” split layout (left text, right illustration).
    - Testimonial band: centered headline with three profile cards; middle card emphasized (elevated/glow).
    - Micro dividers with “AI” label and pink beam flare.
    - Typography: Inter-like grotesk; weights 300–800. Tight letter-spacing in all-caps labels.

## Vanilla CSS (developer-ready)

```css
:root {
    --bg-0: #0B0C0F;
    --bg-1: #0F1115;
    --bg-2: #12141A;
    --panel: rgba(22,24,30,0.72);
    --panel-hi: rgba(28,30,36,0.88);
    --stroke: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    --stroke-hi: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    --text-0: rgba(255,255,255,0.92);
    --text-1: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
    --text-2: rgba(255,255,255,0.56);
    --muted: rgba(255,255,255,0.38);
    --pink-0: #FF3D6E;
    --pink-1: #FF6A8E;
    --blue-0: #0C2B52;
    --blue-1: #0E3A7A;
    --blue-2: #1B55B6;
    --blue-3: #65A9FF;
    --shadow: 0px 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), 0px 40px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    --r-xs: 6px;
    --r-sm: 10px;
    --r-md: 14px;
    --r-lg: 20px;
    --r-xl: 28px;
    --s-2: 8px;
    --s-3: 12px;
    --s-4: 16px;
    --s-5: 20px;
    --s-6: 24px;
    --s-8: 32px;
    --s-10: 40px;
    --s-12: 48px;
    --s-16: 64px;
    --s-24: 96px;
    --s-32: 128px;
    --blur-sm: 8px;
    --blur-md: 16px;
    --blur-lg: 28px;
    --grid: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
}

*,
*::before,
*::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

html, body {
    height: 100%;
    background: radial-gradient(80% 60% at 50% 0%, rgba(255,61,110,0.08) 0px, rgba(255,61,110,0.02) 260px, transparent 560px), var(--bg-0);
    color: var(--text-0);
    font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, "Apple Color Emoji", "Segoe UI Emoji";
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

/* Subtle dot grid like the diagrams */
.bg-grid {
    position: relative;
    background-color: var(--bg-1);
}
.bg-grid::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0px;
    background-image:
        radial-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 24px 24px;
    mask: linear-gradient(180deg, black 40%, transparent 100%);
    pointer-events: none;
}

/* Max layout wrapper */
.container {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0px auto;
    padding-inline: 24px;
}

/* Hairline divider with center label "AI" + beam */
.rule-labeled {
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    margin: var(--s-12) 0px;
    height: 36px;
}
.rule-labeled::before,
.rule-labeled::after {
    content: "";
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0px, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 40px, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) calc(100% - 40px), transparent 100%);
    position: absolute;
    inset: 50% 0px auto 0px;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
}
.rule-labeled .pill {
    padding: 4px 10px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 18px;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--text-1);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,61,110,0.18) 0%, rgba(255,61,110,0.10) 100%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,61,110,0.35);
    box-shadow: 0px 0px 22px rgba(255,61,110,0.35);
}

/* Hero */
.section-hero {
    position: relative;
    padding-top: 160px;
    padding-bottom: 140px;
    background: radial-gradient(60% 40% at 50% 10%, rgba(255,61,110,0.12) 0px, rgba(255,61,110,0.04) 260px, transparent 620px), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-1) 0%, var(--bg-0) 100%);
    overflow: hidden;
}
.hero-title {
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 880px;
    margin: 0px auto var(--s-12);
}
.hero-eyebrow {
    color: var(--muted);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    font-size: 12px;
    line-height: 18px;
    margin-bottom: var(--s-6);
}
.hero-h1 {
    font-size: 48px;
    line-height: 56px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    color: var(--text-0);
}

/* Glass preview panel */
.preview-wrap {
    margin-top: 60px;
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
}
.preview {
    width: 720px;
    height: 380px;
    border-radius: var(--r-lg);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.00) 100%), var(--panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--stroke);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-md));
}
.preview::after {
    /* inner border */
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0px;
    border-radius: inherit;
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    pointer-events: none;
}
.preview-card {
    position: absolute;
    left: 80px;
    top: 80px;
    width: 560px;
    height: 220px;
    border-radius: var(--r-md);
    background: var(--panel-hi);
    border: 1px solid var(--stroke-hi);
    box-shadow: 0px 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
    overflow: hidden;
}
.preview-card .row {
    height: 48px;
    margin: 12px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.06) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 100%);
}

/* Split section: “Build the perfect tools.” */
.section-split {
    padding: 120px 0px;
    background: var(--bg-2);
    position: relative;
}
.split-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 520px 80px 1fr;
    align-items: center;
}
.split-title {
    font-size: 64px;
    line-height: 72px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    margin-bottom: var(--s-8);
}
.split-body {
    color: var(--text-1);
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 26px;
    max-width: 480px;
}
.link-ghost {
    display: inline-flex;
    gap: 8px;
    align-items: center;
    margin-top: var(--s-6);
    color: var(--text-1);
    text-decoration: none;
}
.link-ghost:hover { color: var(--text-0); }

/* Isometric diagram panel */
.iso {
    width: 620px;
    aspect-ratio: 16/10;
    border-radius: var(--r-lg);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15,17,21,1) 0%, rgba(9,10,13,1) 100%);
    border: 1px solid var(--stroke);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}
.iso .grid {
    position: absolute; inset: 0px;
    background-image: radial-gradient(var(--grid) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 18px 18px;
    opacity: 0.7;
}
.layer {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 12% 10% 12% 10%;
    border-radius: 14px;
    transform: perspective(800px) rotateX(55deg) rotateZ(-30deg) translate3d(0px,0px,0px);
    transform-origin: 50% 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(101,169,255,0.18);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(12,43,82,0.7) 0%, rgba(12,43,82,0.2) 100%);
    box-shadow: 0px 40px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
}
.layer.layer-2 {
    inset: 18% 14% 18% 14%;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(14,58,122,0.7) 0%, rgba(14,58,122,0.2) 100%);
}
.layer.highlight {
    inset: 24% 33% 24% 33%;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(27,85,182,0.85) 0%, rgba(101,169,255,0.85) 100%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(101,169,255,0.6);
}

/* Testimonial band */
.section-testimonials {
    padding: 140px 0px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--bg-1) 0%, var(--bg-0) 100%);
}
.testi-head {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: var(--s-12);
}
.testi-sub { color: var(--text-1); }
.cards {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
    align-items: end;
    gap: 32px;
    justify-content: center;
}
.card {
    width: 280px;
    height: 120px;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    border-radius: var(--r-md);
    background: var(--panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--stroke);
    color: var(--text-1);
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 48px 1fr;
    gap: 12px;
    align-content: center;
    backdrop-filter: blur(var(--blur-sm));
}
.card.center {
    width: 360px;
    height: 140px;
    border-radius: 16px;
    background: var(--panel-hi);
    border-color: var(--stroke-hi);
    color: var(--text-0);
    transform: translateY(-16px);
    box-shadow: 0px 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.55), 0px 0px 40px rgba(255,61,110,0.18);
}

/* Micro avatar */
.avatar {
    width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 9999px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
    overflow: hidden;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.12) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.02) 100%);
}

/* Quote text */
.quote {
    font-size: 18px;
    line-height: 28px;
    color: var(--text-0);
}

/* Interactions and motion */
@keyframes floatY {
    0% { transform: translateY(0px); }
    50% { transform: translateY(-6px); }
    100% { transform: translateY(0px); }
}
.preview { animation: floatY 6000ms ease-in-out infinite; }
.layer.highlight { animation: floatY 5200ms ease-in-out infinite; }

/* Hover glow for cards */
.card:hover {
    border-color: var(--stroke-hi);
    box-shadow: 0px 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0px 0px 24px rgba(101,169,255,0.2);
}

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 1100px) {
    .split-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
    .iso { width: 100%; }
    .split-title { font-size: 48px; line-height: 56px; }
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
    .hero-h1 { font-size: 36px; line-height: 44px; }
    .preview { width: 92vw; height: 320px; }
    .preview-card { left: 32px; right: 32px; width: calc(100% - 64px); }
    .cards { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .card, .card.center { width: 100%; transform: none; }
}
```

## Interaction Specs and States

-  Hover focus states:
    - Ghost links: color transitions from var(--text-1) to var(--text-0) in 160ms ease-out.
    - Cards: on hover, border becomes --stroke-hi and adds blue glow; transition 200ms ease.
-  Motion:
    - Floating animation for preview and highlight layer: amplitude 6px over 5200ms–6000ms, ease-in-out, infinite.
-  Entrance (GSAP/Framer suggested):
    - Fade in hero elements with y: 20px, opacity 0 → 1 in 520ms stagger 60ms.
    - Split section: right isometric group slide in from x: 40px, opacity 0 over 640ms.
    - Testimonial center card springs up with scale from 0.96 to 1, damping 16, duration 520ms.
-  Scroll-based glow:
    - As .rule-labeled enters viewport, animate beam box-shadow from 0px to 22px pink and back on loop (optional).

+'use client'
+
+import React, {useMemo, useRef} from 'react'
+import {Canvas, useFrame} from '@react-three/fiber'
+import {OrbitControls} from '@react-three/drei'
+import * as THREE from 'three'
+
+export type OrbProps = {
+	color?: string
+	size?: number
+	className?: string
+}
+
+function useClockUniform() {
+	const timeRef = useRef&lt;number&gt;(0)
+	const uniforms = useMemo(
+		() =&gt; ({
+			u_time: {value: 0},
+		}),
+		[]
+	)
+
+	useFrame((_, delta) =&gt; {
+		timeRef.current += delta
+		// @ts-expect-error uniform dynamic
+		uniforms.u_time.value = timeRef.current
+	})
+
+	return uniforms as {u_time: {value: number}}
+}
+
+function CommonCanvas({children}: {children: React.ReactNode}) {
+	return (
+		&lt;Canvas camera={{position: [0, 0, 3.5], fov: 45}}&gt;
+			&lt;ambientLight intensity={0.5} /&gt;
+			&lt;pointLight position={[4, 6, 8]} intensity={1.2} /&gt;
+			&lt;OrbitControls enableZoom={false} enablePan={false} autoRotate autoRotateSpeed={0.6} /&gt;
+			{children}
+		&lt;/Canvas&gt;
+	)
+}
+
+// 1) EnergyPulseOrb — glossy core + rim-fresnel + breathing pulse
+export function EnergyPulseOrb({color = '#65A9FF', size = 1.1, className = ''}: OrbProps) {
+	const uniforms = useClockUniform()
+	const material = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+		const vertex = &#96;
+varying vec3 vNormal;
+varying vec3 vWorldPos;
+void main(){
+  vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
+  vec4 worldPos = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
+  vWorldPos = worldPos.xyz;
+  gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * worldPos;
+}&#96;
+ 
+ 		const fragment = &#96;
+uniform float u_time;
+uniform vec3 u_color;
+varying vec3 vNormal;
+varying vec3 vWorldPos;
+
+float fresnel(vec3 normal, vec3 viewDir){
+  return pow(1.0 - max(dot(normal, viewDir), 0.0), 2.0);
+}
+
+void main(){
+  vec3 viewDir = normalize(cameraPosition - vWorldPos);
+  float rim = fresnel(normalize(vNormal), viewDir);
+  float pulse = 0.55 + 0.45 * sin(u_time * 2.2);
+  vec3 base = u_color * (0.25 + 0.35 * pulse);
+  vec3 glow = u_color * (1.2 * rim);
+  vec3 color = base + glow;
+  gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 0.95);
+}&#96;
+
+ 		const mat = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
+ 			vertexShader: vertex,
+ 			fragmentShader: fragment,
+ 			transparent: true,
+ 			uniforms: {
+ 				u_time: uniforms.u_time,
+ 				u_color: {value: new THREE.Color(color)},
+ 			},
+ 			depthWrite: false,
+ 			blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
+ 		})
+ 		return mat
+ 	}, [uniforms.u_time, color])
+
+	return (
+ 		&lt;div className={&#96;relative w-full h-full min-h-[220px] ${className}&#96;}&gt;
+ 			&lt;CommonCanvas&gt;
+ 				&lt;mesh&gt;
+ 					&lt;sphereGeometry args={[size, 96, 96]} /&gt;
+ 					&lt;primitive object={material} attach="material" /&gt;
+ 				&lt;/mesh&gt;
+ 			&lt;/CommonCanvas&gt;
+ 		&lt;/div&gt;
+ 	)
+}
+
+// 2) LatticeOrb — animated longitude/latitude grid with subtle emissive
+export function LatticeOrb({color = '#1B55B6', size = 1.1, className = ''}: OrbProps) {
+	const uniforms = useClockUniform()
+	const material = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+ 		const vertex = &#96;
+varying vec3 vPos;
+varying vec2 vUv;
+void main(){
+  vPos = position;
+  vUv = uv;
+  gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
+}&#96;
+
+ 		const fragment = &#96;
+uniform float u_time;
+uniform vec3 u_color;
+varying vec2 vUv;
+
+float line(float v, float width){
+  float a = smoothstep(0.5 - width, 0.5, abs(fract(v) - 0.5));
+  return 1.0 - a;
+}
+
+void main(){
+  float lat = vUv.y * 20.0 + u_time * 0.3; // latitude rings
+  float lon = vUv.x * 20.0 - u_time * 0.25; // longitude rings
+  float grid = max(line(lat, 0.06), line(lon, 0.06));
+  vec3 base = u_color * 0.15;
+  vec3 lines = u_color * (0.9 * grid);
+  vec3 color = base + lines;
+  gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 0.95);
+}&#96;
+
+ 		return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
+ 			vertexShader: vertex,
+ 			fragmentShader: fragment,
+ 			transparent: true,
+ 			uniforms: {u_time: uniforms.u_time, u_color: {value: new THREE.Color(color)}},
+ 			depthWrite: false,
+ 		})
+ 	}, [uniforms.u_time, color])
+
+ 	return (
+ 		&lt;div className={&#96;relative w-full h-full min-h-[220px] ${className}&#96;}&gt;
+ 			&lt;CommonCanvas&gt;
+ 				&lt;mesh&gt;
+ 					&lt;sphereGeometry args={[size, 96, 96]} /&gt;
+ 					&lt;primitive object={material} attach="material" /&gt;
+ 				&lt;/mesh&gt;
+ 			&lt;/CommonCanvas&gt;
+ 		&lt;/div&gt;
+ 	)
+}
+
+// 3) AuroraOrb — flowing color bands simulating aurora using trigonometric distortions
+export function AuroraOrb({color = '#FF3D6E', size = 1.1, className = ''}: OrbProps) {
+	const uniforms = useClockUniform()
+ 	const material = useMemo(() =&gt; {
+ 		const vertex = &#96;
+varying vec3 vWorldPos;
+varying vec3 vNormal;
+void main(){
+  vNormal = normalize(normalMatrix * normal);
+  vec4 worldPos = modelMatrix * vec4(position,1.0);
+  vWorldPos = worldPos.xyz;
+  gl_Position = projectionMatrix * viewMatrix * worldPos;
+}&#96;
+
+ 		const fragment = &#96;
+uniform float u_time;
+uniform vec3 u_color;
+varying vec3 vWorldPos;
+varying vec3 vNormal;
+
+void main(){
+  // Compute spherical coordinates from position
+  float r = length(vWorldPos);
+  float theta = atan(vWorldPos.y, vWorldPos.x);
+  float phi = acos(vWorldPos.z / r);
+
+  float wave = sin(phi * 6.0 + u_time * 1.4) * 0.5 + 0.5;
+  float wave2 = sin(theta * 4.0 - u_time * 1.1) * 0.5 + 0.5;
+  float band = smoothstep(0.35, 0.65, (wave * 0.6 + wave2 * 0.4));
+
+  vec3 aurora = mix(vec3(0.05,0.12,0.2), u_color, band);
+  float rim = pow(1.0 - max(dot(normalize(vNormal), normalize(cameraPosition - vWorldPos)), 0.0), 3.0);
+  vec3 color = aurora + u_color * rim * 0.9;
+  gl_FragColor = vec4(color, 0.9);
+}&#96;
+
+ 		return new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
+ 			vertexShader: vertex,
+ 			fragmentShader: fragment,
+ 			transparent: true,
+ 			uniforms: {u_time: uniforms.u_time, u_color: {value: new THREE.Color(color)}},
+ 			depthWrite: false,
+ 			blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
+ 		})
+ 	}, [uniforms.u_time, color])
+
+ 	return (
+ 		&lt;div className={&#96;relative w-full h-full min-h-[220px] ${className}&#96;}&gt;
+ 			&lt;CommonCanvas&gt;
+ 				&lt;mesh&gt;
+ 					&lt;sphereGeometry args={[size, 96, 96]} /&gt;
+ 					&lt;primitive object={material} attach="material" /&gt;
+ 				&lt;/mesh&gt;
+ 			&lt;/CommonCanvas&gt;
+ 		&lt;/div&gt;
+ 	)
+}
+
+export function OrbsShowcase() {
+ 	return (
+ 		&lt;div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6 w-full max-w-6xl mx-auto p-6 bg-black/60 rounded-xl"&gt;
+ 			&lt;div className="h-[320px]"&gt;&lt;EnergyPulseOrb /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+ 			&lt;div className="h-[320px]"&gt;&lt;LatticeOrb /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+ 			&lt;div className="h-[320px]"&gt;&lt;AuroraOrb /&gt;&lt;/div&gt;
+ 		&lt;/div&gt;
+ 	)
+}
+
